The main takeaway from our work is that
neurotoxicity of antineoplasitc drugs is not always predictable from the knowledge of the antineoplastic mechanisms of action.

the results obtained with neuroprotectants in pre-clinial settings are often not confirmed in clinical trials and this is likely to reflect differences in the neurotoxic mechanisms between pre-clinical models and patients.
